name: GbpChf
summary: This EA trades the GBP/CHF currency pair using a trend-following strategy based on moving average crossovers and momentum confirmation. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when short-term and long-term moving averages cross, with additional filters for trend strength. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA交易英镑/瑞郎货币对，采用基于均线交叉和动量确认的趋势跟踪策略。当短期和长期均线交叉时，沿趋势方向开仓，并附带趋势强度过滤条件。EA包含基于止损和止盈的基本风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，通过快速均线与慢速均线的交叉来判断趋势方向和入场时机。当快速均线上穿慢速均线且动量指标确认上升趋势时开多仓，反之当快速均线下穿慢速均线且动量确认下降趋势时开空仓。出场条件包括达到预设止盈目标、触发止损或出现反向交叉信号。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面设置了硬性止损和止盈，但缺乏追踪止损机制来保护已有利润。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, using crossover signals between fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction and entry timing. It opens long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA with momentum confirmation of an uptrend, and short positions on the reverse crossover with momentum confirming a downtrend. Exit conditions include reaching predefined take profit targets, triggering stop loss levels, or receiving an opposite crossover signal. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management incorporates hard stop loss and take profit levels, but lacks a trailing stop mechanism to protect accumulated profits. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和维护
设置了明确的止损和止盈，风险可控
趋势市场中表现较好，能捕捉中长期趋势行情
均线交叉配合动量确认，减少了虚假信号
代码结构规范，参数可配置性强
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and maintain
Explicit stop loss and take profit settings provide controllable risk
Performs well in trending markets, capturing medium to long-term trends
MA crossover with momentum confirmation reduces false signals
Well-structured code with highly configurable parameters
cons: 固定手数未根据账户规模动态调整，资金管理不够灵活
震荡市场中均线交叉频繁产生虚假信号，可能导致连续亏损
缺乏追踪止损机制，无法在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
仅适用于GBP/CHF单一品种，策略适应性有限
未包含新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account size limits money management flexibility
Frequent false crossover signals in ranging markets may lead to consecutive losses
Lack of trailing stop mechanism prevents locking in more profits during extended trends
Only applicable to GBP/CHF single pair, limiting strategy adaptability
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损和追踪止损，根据市场波动性自动调整风险水平
加入震荡市过滤机制（如ADX或布林带宽度），避免在横盘时频繁交易
实现基于账户余额和风险比例的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and trailing stop to automatically adjust risk levels based on market volatility
Incorporate ranging market filters (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to avoid frequent trading during sideways markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity and risk percentage to replace fixed lot sizing

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查，可能在同一K线上重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定手数不考虑账户规模，小账户可能过度杠杆
震荡市场中连续虚假信号可能导致多次止损累积较大亏损
risk_points_en: No new bar check may lead to duplicate position openings on the same candle, increasing risk exposure
Fixed lot sizing ignores account size, potentially causing over-leveraging in small accounts
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets may result in multiple stop losses accumulating significant losses

It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend when short-term and long-term moving averages cross, with additional filters for trend strength. The EA includes basic risk management with stop loss and take profit levels.
